purpose: Prototype v6q: does I's negative result under the operation that moves sentence-initial pauses into sentences (inside) remain when the own distance is built from I's between-word mean I[2] alone? Asked by the pre-review of outline v13 for the Journal of Writing Research (round 7: R1 M1 and Codex 2, independently): under inside only I[2] of I's three numbers moves (the word-start mean; names as corrected in c72b730: I[0] the mean of all gaps over 200 ms, I[1] the within-word mean, I[2] the word-start mean), while the own distance between a person's two parts carries the differences of all three, so I's negative result may come in part from components that do not respond to the operation making the yardstick larger, and not only from the summary losing the position. Decided by the researcher (decision 33 of .steering/20261108-paper-a-jowr-reframe). Per dataset, baseline and row, the share of persons whose row lies beyond their own parts is counted with I[2] alone (one number, so the distances are absolute differences), on I's rule persons (persons with I and R, v6n's rule cell) and, beside, on I's count 1 persons (gate 0); it is read through the gate R_loc (decision 25) and split by v6p's groups of sentence starts per part. I (three numbers, checked equal to v6n and v6p) is written beside on the same persons. I[0] and I[1] alone are not counted as shares; their invariance under inside is checked.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-09 after seeing the records and notes of v6k-v6p and the pre-review of outline v13 (round 7). The persons are v6m's (= v6n's = v6o's = v6p's), whose values have been seen, including I's shares on these cells and groups, the direction of I[2]'s change (v6n part 2: I[2] rose in .81-.97 of persons under inside and .94-.995 under cross; I[1] did not change for anyone in the dose rows) and the part-to-part reliability of I's three numbers (v6n part 3). No share of I[2] alone (nor of I[0] or I[1] alone) has been computed or looked at. A first draft was sent to Codex (codex-consult, the conditions text and earlier aggregate results only, no data; .steering/20261109-v6q-i2-only-distance/codex-consult-output.md) and changed after its points (decision 1 of that folder).
status: Description (status d) throughout: v6m's persons with v6m's to v6p's values seen, and a distance chosen after reviewers' questions about I's result. The readings below are fixed before any new value is seen; they are not a confirmation. No rule and no label. I[2] alone is not a new rule stage: v6k's rule and labels are not re-evaluated.

sources.v6n: works/conditions/prototype_v6n.json and results/prototype_v6n/record.json: the persons, rows, I's count 1 cells (gate 0) and rule cells (rule_persons) with R_loc and R_mean on the same persons, and their keys; v6n's code is imported.
sources.v6p: works/conditions/prototype_v6p.json and results/prototype_v6p/record.json: the groups of sentence starts per part (v6o's cuts), I's written families per row, baseline and covariate, and I's groups (share, interval, class, state); v6p's and v6o's code is imported.

participants.persons: v6n's (v6m's draw, reused; v6n's checks of the id lists run).
participants.rule_persons: per dataset, baseline and row, I's rule persons: the persons with I and R in the text and the row (v6n's rule cell of I). They are v6o's cell persons (the persons with R; checked as in v6p), so every rule person has v6p's group.
participants.gate_0_persons: per dataset, baseline and row, the persons with I in the text and the row (v6n's count 1 cell of I, gate 0). I[2] exists exactly when I does: I is defined only for a part with at least one gap over 200 ms overall, within words and at word starts (v6k), so I[2] is never taken from an empty set.

units_parts: as v6n: sentences (counting 'before'), parts odd/even and halves. I and I[2] summarise the gaps over 200 ms (v6k's I_MS, with v6's tolerance); the 2 s threshold enters only through the rows' construction (which sentence-initial gaps are long and moved, v6m and v6n).

stages.I[2]: the word-start mean of I alone: the mean of the gaps over 200 ms at word starts in the part, in seconds (v6k's I, third number). The main stage of v6q.
stages.I: v6k's I, three numbers (I[0] the mean of all gaps over 200 ms, I[1] the within-word mean, I[2] the word-start mean), Euclidean distance with the cell's scale (as v6n): recomputed and checked equal to v6n's record (rule cell and count 1 cell) and v6p's record (groups), then written beside I[2] on the same persons.
stages.distance: count 1 of v6b.one on the stage's numbers: per person, change = mean over the two parts of the distance between the row's and the text's vector, base = distance between the text's two parts, both on the cell's scale (each number divided by its standard deviation over the cell's persons and parts; a group keeps its cell's scale, as v6p). For a stage of one number the scale divides change and base alike, so the contribution (1 if change > base, 1/2 if exactly equal in floating point, as v6b.one; 0 if less) does not depend on it: the distances are absolute differences. A standard deviation of 0 stops the run (v6b.one). I[2]'s numbers are I's third number on the same scale as in I's cell, so under a row where I[0] and I[1] do not change, I's change equals I[2]'s and I's base is at least I[2]'s: every person's contribution of I[2] is at least I's (by construction; checked, see fixed_by_construction).

rows: as v6p: v6n's eight dose rows (inside_25/50/75/100, cross_25/50/75/100) and v6k's three main rows (inside/before, shuffled/before, shuffled_in_halves/before). inside/before is the same row as inside_100: written, left out of every count over cells.
fixed_by_construction: under the inside rows (inside_25/50/75/100 and inside/before) each sentence keeps its multiset and a sentence-initial gap is exchanged with a word-start gap of the same sentence (v6m's construction; v6n's correction of the names), so I[0] and I[1] of each part do not change: checked for every rule person and gate 0 person (|change| <= 1e-9 in seconds; the run stops otherwise). Consequently, on the same persons, I[2]'s contribution is at least I's for every person under the inside rows; the number of persons where it is not is written per inside cell (expected 0; a defect if not). Under the other rows nothing is fixed for I[2].

cells.rule_cell: per dataset, baseline and row, on I's rule persons: the share of I[2] and of I beside, the 95% percentile interval of I[2]'s share over 2000 bootstrap resamples of the persons and its class against 0.60 as v6k (above if the lower end is > 0.60, below if the upper end is < 0.60, else undecided); the paired differences I[2] - R_loc and I[2] - I (mean difference of the per-person contributions on the same persons, interval over I[2]'s resamples of the cell, the same resamples for both terms); I's, R_loc's and R_mean's share, interval and class on these persons are v6n's (the rule cell recomputed and checked).
cells.gate_0_cell: per dataset, baseline and row, on I's count 1 persons: the share, interval and class of I[2] and of I (checked equal to v6n's count 1 cell of I). A description beside; not read through the gate (the gate's persons are the persons with R).
cells.keys: numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 100, dataset, task, 22, row index, baseline, group, last]) with v6n's dataset, task and row indices, 22 the stage index of I[2] (v6n's STAGE goes to 12, so no key is shared with v6k-v6p), group 9 for a whole cell, 0-2 low/mid/high by n_s and 10-12 by n_s_min, last 0 on the rule persons and 1 on the gate 0 persons. I's, R_loc's and R_mean's resamples are v6n's (cells) and v6o's and v6p's (groups), recomputed with their keys.

gate_reading: per rule cell, by the gate rule (decision 25) with R_loc's and R_mean's class on the rule persons (v6n): 'gate' if R_loc is above; 'R_mean only' if R_loc is not above and R_mean is; 'not read' otherwise. In 'gate' I[2]'s class is read as the procedure's reading on these persons; in 'R_mean only' it is a description; in 'not read' nothing is said of I[2] in that cell. Every cell's state is counted.

groups.how: v6p's: per dataset, baseline and covariate (n_s, and n_s_min as a sensitivity), the rule persons keep v6o's group and the cell's scale; I[2]'s share, interval and class per group, R_loc's and R_mean's per group (recomputed with v6o's keys and checked equal to v6p's record for I, whose persons are the same), the state by v6p's table ('gate', 'gate in group only', 'R_mean only', 'not read'), I[2] - R_loc and I[2] - I per group (I[2]'s resamples of the group), high - low of I[2] with its interval over the two groups' own resamples, and rising (low <= mid <= high of the point shares). I's groups are recomputed with v6p's keys and checked equal to v6p's record (share, interval, class, state, high - low).
groups.written: a family of I[2]'s groups is written where v6p wrote I's family for the same set, baseline, row and covariate, and withheld (persons per group only, with v6p's reason) where v6p withheld it. Fixed cells: not split.

written_plan.rule: every set over which v6q writes a share (of I[2], I, R_loc or R_mean) is a set over which v6n or v6p already wrote a share of I for the same set, baseline and row: I's rule persons (v6n), I's count 1 persons (v6n), I's written group families (v6p). Checked before anything is written (the run stops otherwise). In addition, for I[2] as a new per-person quantity, the ledger of the sets over which v6q writes I[2]'s share in a row and baseline (rule persons, gate 0 persons, written group families by n_s and n_s_min) is checked by v6p's small_sets: no set of 1-4 persons may be linearly derivable from it (the run stops otherwise). 'Fewer than 5' counts persons. Paired differences, high - low and intervals are over the same persons as a written share and add no set; the count of persons breaking I[2] >= I under inside is a count over the cell's persons (expected 0).
written_plan.guarantee: the guarantee is linear only, as in v6p: it does not cover inference from the values' constraints (contributions are 0, 1/2 or 1, so a share of 0 or 1 tells every member's contribution); such shares over 5 or more persons are written as in v6k-v6p.

primary: named before running and read in this order. (1) The question read first: I[2]'s class on I's rule persons in the primary cells whose state is 'gate' (by v6n's rule cells: LWP odd/even inside_100, LWP halves inside_75 and inside_100), with I[2] - R_loc and the gain I[2] - I. (2) The 12 primary cells: I[2] on I's rule persons at inside_75, inside_100 and cross_100, both sets and both baselines (share, class, state, the paired differences, beside I's share and class). (3) The same 12 cells by n_s (groups), listed and not read one by one. The other cells are listed as a table and not read one by one. Counts of cells are not counts of independent replications.

readings.a: In a primary cell read through the gate: if I[2] is above, on these persons the word-start component alone, with its own part-to-part difference as the yardstick, reaches the operation where the three-number I does not; the paper's statement about I must then say that it concerns the three-number summary with a Euclidean own distance, and that this operation's change is carried by the word-start component. It does not say that I[2] keeps the position in general. If I[2] is below, removing the components that do not move did not bring the share above 0.60 on these persons: I's negative result is not removed by building the yardstick from the moving component alone (this does not exclude that the non-moving components enlarged I's yardstick). If I[2] is undecided, neither is read: counted apart from below. I's own class there is reported as below or undecided, kept apart.
readings.b: Under the inside rows, I[2]'s contribution is at least I's by construction, so I[2] - I >= 0 is not a finding: it is written as the size of the gain on these persons (how much of I's shortfall came from the non-moving components in this count), not as evidence. Under the other rows I[2] - I is a description and may have either sign.
readings.c: I[2] - R_loc with its upper end below 0 in a cell read through the gate says that on these persons I[2] reaches the operation less often than the reference; different numbers of features (1 and 6), not read as 'keeps less of the position'.
readings.d: In a cell where only R_mean reaches, I[2]'s class is a description, as in v6n. Where neither reaches, nothing is said.
readings.e: Groups: v6p's readings (a)-(e), for I[2], as descriptions beside the cells; a group's result is not read as a statement about the persons in it one by one.
readings.f: Under the shuffles and cross, I[2] alone is a description of whether the word-start component's change exceeds its own part-to-part difference; it does not attribute I's results to a component.
readings.intervals: every interval is over the persons of the cell or group with the cell's scale, v6o's cuts and v6n's one random plan per person held fixed; it is not the uncertainty of rerunning the operations, nor does it allow for the distance or the gate having been chosen on these persons.

checks.reuse: before any new quantity is reported, and stopping the run otherwise: v6n's persons and count persons; for both sets, baselines and the eleven rows, v6n's rule cell of I (I, R_loc and R_mean: persons, share_vs_own and its interval; paired_minus_R_loc), recomputed as in v6p; v6n's count 1 cell of I (persons, share_vs_own and its interval); v6o's cuts and persons per group; for I, v6p's plan per family and, where written, v6p's groups (I's and R_loc's and R_mean's share, interval and class; state; high - low and its interval).
checks.construction: I[2] equals I's third number for every person, part and row; I[0] and I[1] do not change under the inside rows (above); every distance is finite and every contribution is 0, 1/2 or 1; the contributions of I give v6n's share; under the inside rows the persons with I[2]'s contribution below I's are counted (expected 0).
checks.groups: the groups partition the rule persons; the groups' shares of I[2] weighted by persons give the rule cell's share of I[2] (1e-12).
checks.sets: every written set is one of I's sets already written, and I[2]'s own ledger per row and baseline makes no set of 1-4 persons derivable (written_plan).
checks.missing: as v6n: a summary over fewer than 5 values is not written; a non-finite value stops the run.

prediction: Claude's, written before running (after codex-consult; the earlier P1, I[2] above I under inside, is true by construction and is dropped). P1: I[2] is above 0.60 in at least 2 of the 3 primary cells read through the gate (LWP odd/even inside_100, LWP halves inside_75 and inside_100). P2: in each of these 3 cells, I[2] - R_loc has its upper end below 0. P3: in KUPA essay I[2] is not above in any of the 6 primary cells (class reported). P4: under the two whole shuffles (shuffled/before and shuffled_in_halves/before), I[2] on I's rule persons is below I's share in at least 6 of the 8 cells (point shares; a description). No new value has been seen.
main_cells: fixed before running, shown first: the 3 gate cells (question read first); the 12 primary cells (I[2], I, state, the paired differences); the 12 primary cells by n_s (groups: I[2] and I per group, state, high - low of I[2]); then per set and baseline a table over the rows of I[2]'s and I's share and class on the rule persons and of I[2]'s on the gate 0 persons; then over all cells except inside/before the counts of cells by state and, within each, of I[2]'s classes, and the same for groups (with families withheld).

record.public: results/prototype_v6q/record.json: counts and summaries over persons and the provenance; no press time, gap, key, text, per-person vector, value, n_s, change or id (ids only as the SHA-256 of their sorted list); a summary over fewer than 5 values is not written. The data are not redistributed.
record.provenance: git commit and dirty state of the conditions, code and lock; SHA-256 of the conditions, the earlier conditions and records, the code and the data; versions.

limits_written_before: The persons are v6m's with v6m's to v6p's values seen, and the distance was chosen after reviewers' questions about I's result: nothing here is a confirmation. I[2] alone is one number: its share is not comparable in scale or number of features with I's or R_loc's; under inside its gain over I is by construction. The direction of I[2]'s change was seen (v6n part 2); count 1 asks whether the change exceeds the person's own part-to-part difference, which was not seen. I[2]'s part-to-part reliability is moderate (v6n part 3, mean rSB: KUPA essay .45, LWP .59, with the names as corrected), so a share of I[2] carries the noise of one number. Groups of about 50-65 persons. The intervals are conditional (readings.intervals). The cells are many and correlated; no correction. I and I[2] summarise gaps over 200 ms; the 2 s threshold enters only through the rows. A share shows sensitivity of a summary to a difference in press times; it says nothing about the cognitive meaning of a pause or the quality of a text.
rerun_rule: as v6k: if a defect of the code is found after the first run, the first record is kept unchanged, the fix and the reason are committed, and the rerun is reported separately beside the first.
generator: as v6k (checked by v6k's code against v6k's conditions).
implementation: the bootstrap interval is v6.ci (2.5th and 97.5th numpy percentiles, linear); the per-person contributions are v6o's contrib_base_change (checked against v6m's own_contrib); inside/before is the same row as inside_100 and is written but left out of every count over cells.
